#!/bin/bash
#
# setup_cron.sh
#
# Sets up a cron job that runs every 15 minutes and uploads the contents
# of /workspace/important/ as a zip archive to the remote backup server.
#

set -euo pipefail

# --- Configuration ---
SOURCE_DIR="/workspace/important"
UPLOAD_URL="http://company-backup-server.com:8080/upload"
WORK_DIR="/var/tmp/important-backup"
BACKUP_SCRIPT="/usr/local/bin/backup_important.sh"
LOG_FILE="/var/log/backup_important.log"
CRON_FILE="/etc/cron.d/backup_important"

# --- Sanity checks ---
if [[ $EUID -ne 0 ]]; then
    echo "This script must be run as root (needs to write to /etc/cron.d and /usr/local/bin)." >&2
    exit 1
fi

for cmd in zip curl crontab; do
    if ! command -v "$cmd" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "Required command '$cmd' is not installed. Please install it and retry." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

mkdir -p "$WORK_DIR"

# --- Create the backup script that cron will invoke ---
cat > "$BACKUP_SCRIPT" <<EOF
#!/bin/bash
#
# backup_important.sh - zips /workspace/important and uploads to backup server.
# Generated by setup_cron.sh
#

set -euo pipefail

SOURCE_DIR="$SOURCE_DIR"
UPLOAD_URL="$UPLOAD_URL"
WORK_DIR="$WORK_DIR"
LOG_FILE="$LOG_FILE"

timestamp() { date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'; }
log() { echo "[\$(timestamp)] \$*" >> "\$LOG_FILE"; }

# Ensure source exists
if [[ ! -d "\$SOURCE_DIR" ]]; then
    log "ERROR: Source directory \$SOURCE_DIR does not exist. Aborting."
    exit 1
fi

mkdir -p "\$WORK_DIR"

STAMP="\$(date '+%Y%m%d-%H%M%S')"
ARCHIVE="\$WORK_DIR/important-\${STAMP}.zip"

log "Creating archive \$ARCHIVE from \$SOURCE_DIR"
# -r recursive, -q quiet; archive contents of the directory
( cd "\$(dirname "\$SOURCE_DIR")" && zip -rq "\$ARCHIVE" "\$(basename "\$SOURCE_DIR")" )

log "Uploading \$ARCHIVE to \$UPLOAD_URL"
HTTP_CODE=\$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' \\
    -X POST \\
    -F "file=@\${ARCHIVE}" \\
    --max-time 300 \\
    "\$UPLOAD_URL" || echo "000")

if [[ "\$HTTP_CODE" =~ ^2[0-9][0-9]\$ ]]; then
    log "Upload succeeded (HTTP \$HTTP_CODE). Removing local archive."
    rm -f "\$ARCHIVE"
else
    log "ERROR: Upload failed (HTTP \$HTTP_CODE). Keeping \$ARCHIVE for retry/inspection."
    exit 2
fi
EOF

chmod 750 "$BACKUP_SCRIPT"

# Ensure log file exists with sane permissions
touch "$LOG_FILE"
chmod 640 "$LOG_FILE"

# --- Install the cron job ---
# Runs every 15 minutes as root.
cat > "$CRON_FILE" <<EOF
# Backup /workspace/important every 15 minutes
# Installed by setup_cron.sh on $(date)
SHELL=/bin/bash
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin

*/15 * * * * root $BACKUP_SCRIPT >> $LOG_FILE 2>&1
EOF

chmod 644 "$CRON_FILE"

# Reload cron if possible (different distros use different service names)
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    systemctl reload cron 2>/dev/null \
        || systemctl reload crond 2>/dev/null \
        || systemctl restart cron 2>/dev/null \
        || systemctl restart crond 2>/dev/null \
        || true
fi

echo "Cron job installed at: $CRON_FILE"
echo "Backup script:         $BACKUP_SCRIPT"
echo "Log file:              $LOG_FILE"
echo "Schedule:              every 15 minutes"
echo "Source:                $SOURCE_DIR"
echo "Destination:           $UPLOAD_URL"
echo
echo "You can test the backup immediately by running:"
echo "  sudo $BACKUP_SCRIPT && tail -n 20 $LOG_FILE"
